rust_summary: a player finishing a sign, rewritable or cancellable (`native_sign_changed`).
doc_summary: a player finishing a sign: `native_sign_changed(player, name, dimension, pos, front, lines, cancel)` is heard when a player sends the text they wrote on a sign they were editing, right before it goes on the sign, once the checks have passed, on a server, with the player's state swapped in (`native_tell` reaches them). A mod may rewrite `lines` (four lines of plain text) or set `cancel` so the sign keeps its old text; a waxed sign is not told. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:native_sign_changed@.
